{{Top}}
{{Quote|Chieftain Thi-Sen welcomes you to his home and hopes you come in peace.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref>}}
[[File:ChiefBast.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Chief [[Moradmin Bast/Legends|Moradmin Bast]]]]

A '''chief''' or '''chieftain''' was the leader of a tribe, village, or town and often primitive societies. Cultures that had chiefs, or chieftains include the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanian]], [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand people]], [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], [[Felucian/Legends|Felucians]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]]. Chief [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] was the chief of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

A chief was also the title of a manager or overseer, especially in military organizations, such as Chief [[Moradmin Bast/Legends|Bast]] and Chief Engineer [[Olum]]. [[Hurdiss]] served as a [[communications chief]] aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. [[Siward Cass/Legends|Siward Cass]] also acted as the communications chief aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] before [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

Chief could also be a shortened name for a title including chief, such as [[Chief Justice]] or [[Chief of State]].
